articles.title: Why Southeast Asia's Clean Energy Surge Could Stall Before It Starts
articles.description: Southeast Asia has been hit harder than anywhere else on Earth by the energy crisis stemming from the War in Iran, leaving many nations scrambling to shore up localized energy supply chains. articles.description: The months-long closure of the Strait of Hormuz has led to severe fuel shortages around the globe, as companies battle to continue operations. articles.description: Citi has raised its third-quarter Brent crude forecast to $80 per barrel from $75 as the U.S.-Iran war drags on and repeated attempts at a deal fail to restore normal oil flows through the Strait of Hormuz.
